description:
The U.S. Army Contracting Command, Aberdeen Proving Ground (ACC-APG) on behalf of the Communications-Electronics Command Security Assistance Management directorate (CECOM SAMD) is issuing this Sources Sought notice as a means of conducting market research to identify potential sources having an interest in, industry technologies available and capability to fulfill FMS requirements.See the attached document for detailed information.

Disclaimer: Place of Performance Location is TBD. For the purpose of being able to post this Sources Sought, Aberdeen Proving Ground is listed for now. This will be updated if a future requirement results from this action.
